facts.fact: "Heaven Sent" is the eleventh episode of the ninth series of Doctor Who, first broadcast on BBC One on 28 November 2015.
The episode was written by Steven Moffat and directed by Rachel Talalay.
The Twelfth Doctor, played by Peter Capaldi, is imprisoned in a waterlocked castle by the Time Lords in this episode.
The episode primarily features the Doctor without a companion or any guest speaking characters.
The script for this episode can be found in a PDF published by the BBC.

sources.title: Heaven Sent (Doctor Who) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet:
"Heaven Sent" is the eleventh and penultimate episode of the ninth series "Doctor Who (series 9)") of the British science fiction television series Doctor Who. It was first broadcast on BBC One on 28 November 2015. It was written by Steven Moffat and directed by Rachel Talalay.

In the episode, the alien time traveller the Twelfth Doctor (Peter Capaldi) is imprisoned in a waterlocked castle by his people, the Time Lords. A shrouded creature (Jami Reid-Quarrell) pursues the Doctor in an attempt to interrogate truths from him. The episode is a bottle episode that primarily features the Doctor without a companion or any guest speaking characters. It was watched by 6.19 million viewers in the United Kingdom. # Notes on Heaven Sent, Part 1

Below I have broken down scene 1 of the BBC-published script for Doctor Who S09E11 and annotated it with a combinations of notes, thoughts, and questions.
